blast-fungus.en: Only the bravest of warriors carry the Blast Fungus. Not just because of its toxic spores, but because it smells awful.
blast-fungus.zh-Hant: 只有最勇敢的戰士才會攜帶爆裂真菌。這不只因為它帶有毒孢子，也因為它聞起來很難聞。

boots-of-swiftness.en: Boots blessed with enchantments to allow for swift movements. Useful in uncertain times such as these.
boots-of-swiftness.zh-Hant: 這雙靴子受到附魔祝福，能讓人迅速移動。在如今局勢難料的時刻尤其實用。

buzzy-nest.en: Bee lovers and the bee-loved alike are fans of the Buzzy Nest, but don't be fooled by the cute bees within - they pack a powerful sting!
buzzy-nest.zh-Hant: 愛蜂人士與深受蜜蜂喜愛的人都很喜歡蜂巢，但別被裡頭可愛的蜜蜂騙了——牠們的螫刺相當厲害！

corrupted-beacon.en: The Corrupted Beacon holds immense power within. It waits for the moment to unleash its wrath.
corrupted-beacon.zh-Hant: 腐化信標蘊藏著龐大力量，正等待釋放怒火的時刻。

corrupted-pumpkin.en: The Corrupted Pumpkin glows with supernatural power, illuminating even the darkest nights with its powerful beacon.
corrupted-pumpkin.zh-Hant: 腐化南瓜散發超自然力量，強光足以照亮最黑暗的夜晚。

corrupted-seeds.en: A pouch of poisonous corrupted seeds which grow into spiky grapple vines, entangling and slowly draining the life from its victims.
corrupted-seeds.zh-Hant: 一袋充滿毒性的腐化種子，會長成帶刺的攀爬藤蔓，纏住目標並慢慢吸取其生命。

death-cap-mushroom.en: Eaten by daring warriors before battle, the Death Cap Mushroom drives fighters into a frenzy.
death-cap-mushroom.zh-Hant: 勇敢的戰士會在戰前吃下死亡帽菇，使自己陷入狂熱狀態。

enchanted-grass.en: Just as there are powerful heroes who answer the call to fight, there are powerful enchanted sheep who will join the fight when summoned.
enchanted-grass.zh-Hant: 正如有強大的英雄響應戰鬥號召，召喚時也會有強大的附魔綿羊加入戰鬥。

enchanters-tome.en: Meant only to be wielded by Enchanters, the magic of this artifact can summon powerful enchantments.
enchanters-tome.zh-Hant: 此神器只供附魔師使用，其中的魔法能召喚強大的附魔。

eye-of-the-guardian.en: The Eye of the Guardian holds a power that awakens in the hands of a worthy hero.
eye-of-the-guardian.zh-Hant: 守衛之眼蘊藏一股力量，會在有資格的英雄手中覺醒。

fireworks-arrow.en: The explosive power of the TNT combined with the high velocity movement of an arrow - what could possibly go wrong?
fireworks-arrow.zh-Hant: 將 TNT 的爆炸威力與箭矢的高速結合，還有什麼可能出錯？

fishing-rod.en: The trusted companion of any true adventurer, the Fishing Rod is useful for more than just fishing.
fishing-rod.zh-Hant: 每位真正冒險者的可靠夥伴，釣魚竿可不只用來釣魚。

flaming-quiver.en: This quiver is filled with the deadliest of arrows.
flaming-quiver.zh-Hant: 這個箭袋裝滿了最致命的箭矢。

ghost-cloak.en: The souls trapped within the Ghost Cloak are protective, but they radiate a sense of melancholy.
ghost-cloak.zh-Hant: 幽靈斗篷困住的靈魂會保護持有者，但也散發著憂傷。

golem-kit.en: Iron Golems have always protected the Villagers of the Overworld. Their numbers are dwindling as a result of the Arch Illager's war.
golem-kit.zh-Hant: 鐵魔像一直守護著主世界的村民。由於 Arch-Illager 發動戰爭，牠們的數量正逐漸減少。

gong-of-weakening.en: This ancient gong, marked with the symbols of a nameless kingdom, feels safe in your hands but emits a menacing hum to those nearby.
gong-of-weakening.zh-Hant: 這面古老銅鑼刻著一個無名王國的符號，握在手中令人安心，卻會向附近的人發出不祥的嗡鳴。

harpoon-quiver.en: This quiver holds a number of harpoons that swiftly pierce through enemies on land or underwater.
harpoon-quiver.zh-Hant: 這個箭袋裝有多枚魚叉，能迅速刺穿陸地上或水下的敵人。

harvester.en: The Harvester siphons the souls of the dead, before releasing them into a cluster hex of power.
harvester.zh-Hant: 收割者會抽取死者的靈魂，再將其釋放成一團強力的咒能。

ice-wand.en: The Ice Wand was trapped in a tomb of ice for ages, sealed away by those who feared its power.
ice-wand.zh-Hant: 冰杖被封在冰墓中多年，曾被畏懼它力量的人封存。

iron-hide-amulet.en: The Iron Hide Amulet is both ancient and timeless. Sand mysteriously and endlessly slips through the cracks in the iron.
iron-hide-amulet.zh-Hant: 鐵皮護符既古老又歷久不衰。沙粒神秘地無止盡地從鐵縫中滑落。

light-feather.en: No one knows what mysterious creature this feather came from, but it is as beautiful and powerful.
light-feather.zh-Hant: 無人知曉這根羽毛來自什麼神秘生物，但它既美麗又強大。

lightning-rod.en: Crafted by Illager Geomancers, this item is enchanted with the power of a storming sky.
lightning-rod.zh-Hant: 這件物品由掠奪者地卜師打造，並附魔了風暴天空的力量。

love-medallion.en: A spell radiates from this trinket, enchanting those nearby into a trance where they must protect the holder of the medallion at all costs.
love-medallion.zh-Hant: 這枚飾物散發著一道咒語，讓附近的人陷入恍惚，必須不惜一切代價保護護身符持有者。

powershaker.en: The Powershaker is a smashing good time, though it may not be as fun for your enemies.
powershaker.zh-Hant: 力量搖搖棒能帶來痛快的粉碎體驗，不過對敵人而言就沒那麼有趣了。

satchel-of-elixirs.en: The Satchel of Elixirs always contains the exact potions you need! (Well, at least the potions it thinks you need, which is still pretty helpful.)
satchel-of-elixirs.zh-Hant: 藥劑袋總會裝著你需要的藥水！（至少是它認為你需要的藥水；而這依然相當有幫助。）

satchel-of-elements.en: Mysteries surround this primordial satchel. Will it unleash fire, ice, or something a lot less nice?
satchel-of-elements.zh-Hant: 這個原初小袋籠罩在謎團之中。它會釋放火焰、冰霜，還是更糟的東西？

satchel-of-snacks.en: The Satchel of Snacks provides a treat when you need it most!
satchel-of-snacks.zh-Hant: 零食袋會在你最需要時送上一份點心！

scatter-mines.en: Set your enemies up for the surprise of a lifetime with the explosive power of Scatter Mines.
scatter-mines.zh-Hant: 用散射地雷的爆炸威力，讓敵人迎來畢生難忘的驚喜。

shadow-shifter.en: The Shadow Shifter grants you Shadow Form, which allows you to stay out of sight.
shadow-shifter.zh-Hant: 暗影轉換器賦予你暗影形態，讓你不被人發現。

shock-powder.en: Shock Powder is a reliable tool for those who wish to make a swift exit.
shock-powder.zh-Hant: 震擊粉是想迅速脫身者可靠的工具。

soul-healer.en: The Soul Healer amulet is cold to the touch and trembles with the power of souls.
soul-healer.zh-Hant: 靈魂治療護符摸起來冰冷，並因靈魂的力量而顫動。

soul-lantern.en: This lantern, still covered in the sands of some far-flung place, allows those who hold it to summon a creature formed from bound souls.
soul-lantern.zh-Hant: 這盞提燈仍覆著來自某個遙遠之地的沙塵，能讓持有者召喚由受縛靈魂形成的生物。

spinblade.en: This whirling weapon spins across the battlefield, slicing through enemies in its path.
spinblade.zh-Hant: 這把旋轉武器會飛旋穿越戰場，切割路徑上的敵人。

tasty-bone.en: You hear distant howling as you hold the Tasty Bone in your hand.
tasty-bone.zh-Hant: 手握美味骨頭時，你會聽見遠處傳來的嗥叫聲。

thundering-quiver.en: This copper quiver channels the power of lightning.
thundering-quiver.zh-Hant: 這個銅製箭袋能引導閃電的力量。

tome-of-duplication.en: A magical tome which when read is capable of duplicating items such as food, potions and explosives!
tome-of-duplication.zh-Hant: 一本魔法書，閱讀後能複製食物、藥水、炸藥等物品！

torment-quiver.en: The Torment Quiver radiates powerful energy drawn from the eternal source of the Undead.
torment-quiver.zh-Hant: 苦痛箭袋散發強大的能量，源自亡靈的永恆力量。

totem-of-casting.en: All who are near this totem feel an invigorating aura around their artifacts.
totem-of-casting.zh-Hant: 靠近圖騰的人都會感受到一股振奮精神的氣息，從神器散發而出。

totem-of-regeneration.en: This hand-crafted wooden figurine radiates a warmth like that of a crackling campfire, healing those who gather around it.
totem-of-regeneration.zh-Hant: 這尊手工製作的木雕散發著篝火般的溫暖，療癒聚集在它周圍的人。

totem-of-shielding.en: This totem radiates powerful energy that bursts forth as a protective shield around those near it.
totem-of-shielding.zh-Hant: 這個圖騰散發強大能量，並釋出保護附近之人的護盾。

updraft-tome.en: An ancient book filled with illegible glyphs, you feel a strange breeze as you flip through the pages.
updraft-tome.zh-Hant: 一本古老的書，裡頭滿是無法辨識的字符。翻頁時，你會感到一陣奇異微風。

vexing-chant.en: Summons Guardian Vexes who will fight by your side for a short time.
vexing-chant.zh-Hant: 召喚守衛惱鬼，牠們會在短時間內與你並肩作戰。

void-quiver.en: The Void Quiver is filled with arrows that splash Void Liquid when they hit their target.
void-quiver.zh-Hant: 虛空箭袋裝滿命中目標時會濺出虛空液體的箭矢。

wind-horn.en: When the Wind Horn echoes throughout the forests of the Overworld the creatures of the night tremble with fear.
wind-horn.zh-Hant: 當風之號角的聲音響徹主世界的森林，夜間生物便會驚恐顫抖。

wonderful-wheat.en: This item has the faint smell of an open field, baked bread, and freshly cut crops.
wonderful-wheat.zh-Hant: 這件物品散發著淡淡氣味，令人想起空曠田野、烘焙麵包與剛收割的作物。
